rule: Art. 40(1) and Art. 43(1) AIA read with Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2026/2274 (reference of EN 18286:2026 published in the Official Journal)

sources.pinpoint: Art. 1 and Annex, point 1 (EN 18286:2026, Artificial intelligence - Quality management system for EU AI Act regulatory purposes); Art. 2 (entry into force on the day of publication, 14.10.2026); recitals 1, 3 and 6

Art. 40(1) (presumption of conformity with the requirements set out in Section 2 of Chapter III or the Chapter V obligations); Art. 17 (Chapter III, Section 3); Art. 43(1), first and second subparagraphs; Art. 43(2)
Art. 1, point (19): Art. 43(3) replaced, last subparagraph

interpretations.text: Art. 40(1) presumes conformity with the requirements set out in Section 2 of Chapter III (Arts. 8 to 15) or the Chapter V obligations. The quality management system is Art. 17, in Section 3, and Decision (EU) 2026/2274 names no AI Act article: its recital 1 speaks of 'the requirements covered by those standards'. Whether EN 18286:2026 gives a presumption for Art. 17 is left to review; the classifier names the standard and does not apply a presumption.

Art. 43(1) opens internal control (Annex VI) for an Annex III, point 1 system only where the provider has applied harmonised standards or common specifications in demonstrating compliance with the Section 2 requirements, and requires Annex VII where none exist or the provider applied only part of one. EN 18286:2026 is by its title a quality management system standard, so the classifier reads it as not covering the Section 2 requirements: applying it alone does not open Annex VI.

cases.facts: A provider of a credit-scoring system (Annex III, point 5(b)). The Art. 40 item names the published standard and leaves its reach to review.

Art. 40 AIA: Quality management system for EU AI Act regulatory purposes

cases.facts: A provider of a remote biometric identification system (Annex III, point 1(a)). Art. 43(1) decides between Annex VI and Annex VII, and EN 18286:2026 alone does not open Annex VI.
A provider of an emotion recognition system (Annex III, point 1(c)).
A provider of a credit-scoring system (Annex III, point 5(b)). Art. 43(2) fixes internal control; the Art. 43(1) choice does not arise.
A provider of a system in an Annex III area whose point is unsettled; it may be point 1.

Art. 43 AIA: If the system falls in Annex III, point 1

cases.facts: A remote biometric identification system (Annex III, point 1(a)) that is also a safety component of a medical device (Annex I, Section A, point 11) needing third-party conformity assessment. Art. 43(3), last subparagraph, as replaced by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, sends it to the medical-device procedure, so the Art. 43(1) choice does not arise.

A remote biometric identification system (Annex III, point 1(a)) that is also a safety component of a motor vehicle (Annex I, Section B, point 18). Art. 43(3) names Section A only, so the Annex III duties kept for review include the Art. 43(1) choice.
A deployer, not the provider, of a remote biometric identification system. Arts. 40 and 43 are provider duties.
A provider of a system that is in no Annex III area and no Annex I product.
